text: Federal regulations specify when you must use supplemental oxygen. If you are planning a flight with a cruise altitude over 12,000 feet, you should consult these regulations. As a general rule, consider using supplemental oxygen when you fly above 10,000 feet during the day or above 5,000 feet at night. When, generally speaking, should supplemental oxygen be used?
